headline: Weathered Expanse Surges as Passage Battle Holds
war_summary: Since the last edition the Weathered Expanse has surged to the head of the wire with thirty-seven changes in twenty-four hours, four in the last two, holdings now four Warden to five Colonial about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Huntsfort, with day losses near eleven thousand nine hundred Colonial and sixteen thousand seven hundred Warden and hourly rates accelerating. Callahan's Passage remains hot with twenty-two changes on the day, three in two hours, holdings eight Warden to two Colonial about Crumbling Post, The Crumbling Passage and The Latch. The Nevish Line shows fourteen changes on the day, one in two hours, holdings six Warden to two Colonial about Blackcoat Way and Princefal. Stlican Shelf counts seventeen changes, two in two hours, holdings three Warden, five Colonial and one in no-man's-land about Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, while Stonecradle counts nineteen but none in two hours. Linn Mercy and Palantine Berm have gone quiet in two hours after seven changes each, and most other regions report no base changes despite continued casualties and enlistments.
